chapterTitle: Chapter 1: The Alphabet A to Z 🔤
learningGoals: Identify and recite all 26 letters of the English alphabet in correct order. 🎶
Easily match big (uppercase) letters with their small (lowercase) friends. 👯
Recognize the 5 special vowel friends: A, E, I, O, and U. 🌟
Understand the sounds each letter makes to start reading simple words! 📖
teachingTips: Sing the ABC song together while pointing to each letter on a chart or book. It builds memory and confidence! 🎤
Point out uppercase and lowercase letters on food boxes, toys, and street signs during your daily routine. 🥣
When talking about vowels, hold up 5 fingers and name them: A, E, I, O, U. Call them the 'superstar letters'! ⭐
Keep practice times very short and playful. A 5-minute game with lots of high-fives is perfect for Class 1! ✋

funActivities.title: Big and Small Letter Match-Up 🧩
funActivities.description: Write big letters on paper cups and small letters on sticky notes. Let your child stick the right note onto the matching cup. Celebrate every match!

funActivities.title: Vowel Hunt 🔍
funActivities.description: Give your child a favorite storybook and ask them to find and point to as many vowels (A, E, I, O, U) as they can on one page. Help them sound out the words!

funActivities.title: Alphabet Train 🚂
funActivities.description: Write letters on different blocks or toy cars. Mix them up and ask your child to line them up in the correct alphabetical order to make a long, happy ABC train.
